level_normalized_shape_comparison.protocol:
Clean held-note option contrasts; fixed source-relative windows, stereo power.
No recording targets, feature fitting or perceptual-realism claim.
level_normalized_shape_comparison.normalization: Stereo average power, each note divided by its own0–500ms stereoRMS². WAVs match that RMS to0.035. Fixed note-on windows; no onset/time shift. Default Spruce/Original/Touch.58/Pluck.28/Body.82/Stereo.62, same seed per fresh engine.

recorded_training.protocol:
Fixed training-only comparison for the picking/body feedback change.

Uses the existing Yamaha/Walden nine training pitches, original file selection,
feature extractor, weights, MIDI velocity and Auditorium settings. No fitting,
development pitches or protected corpus. Two immutable renderer snapshots.
recorded_training.interpretation: Original/Auditorium changes: Yamaha nylon total improves, Walden steel total worsens. Both attack terms worsen. Not a universal recording-realism improvement; no fitting/development scoring.

limitations: No listening panel or perceptual threshold is established by normalized spectral contrast.
Some shape pairs/windows become less distinct; all pair summaries are retained.
PSD residues and positive damping are the analytic passive-section argument; sampled physical-string directions alone are not a full-matrix proof.
Stationary passivity checks do not establish passivity under arbitrary time-varying construction changes.
Existing bridge-mode transition resets its modal histories and rebases the audio derivative; string/tail state is preserved and radiation crossfades.
Full native/plugin qualification and callback evidence are owned by the root report, not duplicated here.
